Open data · free · no account

Records

Every pin on the map, as a table you can filter and download. Each row is an incident reported in the news, filed under one of the map's streams (Crime & Security, Infrastructure, Priority Intelligence, Africa & World), that FORGE checked by hand and the owner approved before it went on the map. Nothing here is behind a paywall or a sign-in.

Read this before using the data

  • These are hand-checked news reports of incidents across the map's streams, not statistics. They are not complete and not representative of everything that happens in any area.
  • Most rows rest on a single report or on police statements repeated by several outlets; see reporting_independence.
  • Map points are approximate. uncertainty_m says how far off a point can be, and location_basis says when a point is inferred or estimated rather than reported.
  • Reports can be wrong or change after publication. Check the source links before relying on any row.

What each CSV column means
signal_id
FORGE's ID for the pin.
short_id
First 8 characters of the ID, as used in map links.
title
The pin's title on the map.
province
Province of the batch the pin was published in.
stream
The map stream the pin is filed under, as named in the map's Streams panel: Crime & Security, Infrastructure, Priority Intelligence or Africa & World.
incident_start
When the incident happened or began, as best the reports allow (ISO 8601).
incident_precision
How exact incident_start is: time, approx_time, part_of_day or day.
incident_event
occurred = when it happened; found = when a body was found.
incident_described
The incident time in words, with who gave it.
reported_at
Date of the earliest report found (not proven to be the first).
location_described
Where the reports place it, and what the map point marks.
latitude
Map point latitude, rounded to 5 decimals. Not an exact scene.
longitude
Map point longitude, rounded to 5 decimals. Not an exact scene.
map_precision
What the map point stands for: spot, street, area, suburb, village, town, farm or precinct (an estimate for the police area only).
uncertainty_m
How far, at most, the real place can plausibly be from the point, in metres.
location_basis
reported = the reports name this place; inferred = FORGE's reading of a place the reports do not pin down; estimated = the place could not be mapped, so the point stands for the police area that handled the case.
reporting_independence
Whether the reports are independent of each other (most are not).
statement_from
Who the reporting rests on, usually police.
outlets
News outlets that reported it, separated by ' | '.
source_urls
Source article links, separated by ' | '.
source_count
Number of source articles linked.
archived_source_count
How many of those links have a saved archive copy.
fact_conflict_count
Facts on which the reports disagree.
fact_audit
Whether the pin's key facts were checked claim by claim against the sources.
approval_id
The owner approval record this row matches.
pin_version
Version of the pin's approved data.
approved_at
When that approval was given.
published_at
When the pin went on the map.
map_link
The pin on the map (relative to the site).
data_version
Git commit of the pin and approval files this export was built from.
